name: Level_1 - Task_6
description: Prepare an equilibrated aluminum state near 300 K for a later vibration calculation. Build a periodic primitive FCC cell with conventional lattice parameter 4.05 Å and repeat it 4 × 4 × 4 to make 64 atoms. Use the supplied MACE-MP-0 model and keep the cell fixed. Initialize Maxwell–Boltzmann velocities at 300 K with a recorded random seed, then remove center-of-mass momentum once. Choose a suitable thermostat, timestep, run length, and sampling interval. Do not reinitialize or rescale the velocities during the run. Save the thermal trace, sampled trajectory, and restartable final state. Use the saved data to show that the state is ready for the later NVE run.
submission_format: Submit the path to one JSON manifest inside the task workspace. Link the trajectory, thermal trace, final state, settings, and scripts needed to check the preparation. The shared blank manifest also has fields for later Level 2 work; leave those fields empty. Paths may be relative to the manifest.
